en.text: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

zhSimplified.text: 夏天落雪，收割时下雨，都不相宜； 愚昧人得尊荣也是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 夏天落雪，收割時下雨，都不相宜； 愚昧人得尊榮也是如此。

en.text: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

zhSimplified.text: 麻雀往来，燕子翻飞； 这样，无故的咒诅也必不临到。

zhTraditional.text: 麻雀往來，燕子翻飛； 這樣，無故的咒詛也必不臨到。

en.text: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

zhSimplified.text: 鞭子是为打马，辔头是为勒驴； 刑杖是为打愚昧人的背。

zhTraditional.text: 鞭子是為打馬，轡頭是為勒驢； 刑杖是為打愚昧人的背。

en.text: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

zhSimplified.text: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他， 恐怕你与他一样。

zhTraditional.text: 不要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他， 恐怕你與他一樣。

en.text: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 要照愚昧人的愚妄话回答他， 免得他自以为有智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 要照愚昧人的愚妄話回答他， 免得他自以為有智慧。

en.text: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

zhSimplified.text: 借愚昧人手寄信的， 是砍断自己的脚，自受损害。

zhTraditional.text: 藉愚昧人手寄信的， 是砍斷自己的腳，自受損害。

en.text: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

zhSimplified.text: 瘸子的脚空存无用； 箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 瘸子的腳空存無用； 箴言在愚昧人的口中也是如此。

en.text: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

zhSimplified.text: 将尊荣给愚昧人的， 好像人把石子包在机弦里。

zhTraditional.text: 將尊榮給愚昧人的， 好像人把石子包在機弦裏。

en.text: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

zhSimplified.text: 箴言在愚昧人的口中， 好像荆棘刺入醉汉的手。

zhTraditional.text: 箴言在愚昧人的口中， 好像荊棘刺入醉漢的手。

en.text: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

zhSimplified.text: 雇愚昧人的，与雇过路人的， 就像射伤众人的弓箭手。

zhTraditional.text: 雇愚昧人的，與雇過路人的， 就像射傷眾人的弓箭手。

en.text: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行， 就如狗转过来吃它所吐的。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧人行愚妄事，行了又行， 就如狗轉過來吃牠所吐的。

en.text: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

zhSimplified.text: 你见自以为有智慧的人吗？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。

zhTraditional.text: 你見自以為有智慧的人嗎？ 愚昧人比他更有指望。

en.text: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人说：道上有猛狮， 街上有壮狮。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人說：道上有猛獅， 街上有壯獅。

en.text: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

zhSimplified.text: 门在枢纽转动， 懒惰人在床上也是如此。

zhTraditional.text: 門在樞紐轉動， 懶惰人在床上也是如此。

en.text: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人放手在盘子里， 就是向口撤回也以为劳乏。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人放手在盤子裏， 就是向口撤回也以為勞乏。

en.text: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人看自己比七个善于应对的人更有智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人看自己比七個善於應對的人更有智慧。

en.text: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

zhSimplified.text: 过路被事激动，管理不干己的争竞， 好像人揪住狗耳。

zhTraditional.text: 過路被事激動，管理不干己的爭競， 好像人揪住狗耳。

en.text: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

zhSimplified.text: 人欺凌邻舍，却说： 我岂不是戏耍吗？ 他就像疯狂的人抛掷火把、利箭， 与杀人的兵器。

zhTraditional.text: 人欺凌鄰舍，卻說： 我豈不是戲耍嗎？ 他就像瘋狂的人拋擲火把、利箭， 與殺人的兵器。

en.text: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

zhSimplified.text: 火缺了柴就必熄灭； 无人传舌，争竞便止息。

zhTraditional.text: 火缺了柴就必熄滅； 無人傳舌，爭競便止息。

en.text: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

zhSimplified.text: 好争竞的人煽惑争端， 就如余火加炭，火上加柴一样。

zhTraditional.text: 好爭競的人煽惑爭端， 就如餘火加炭，火上加柴一樣。

en.text: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

zhSimplified.text: 传舌人的言语，如同美食， 深入人的心腹。

zhTraditional.text: 傳舌人的言語，如同美食， 深入人的心腹。

en.text: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

zhSimplified.text: 火热的嘴，奸恶的心， 好像银渣包的瓦器。

zhTraditional.text: 火熱的嘴，奸惡的心， 好像銀渣包的瓦器。

en.text: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

zhSimplified.text: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉饰， 心里却藏着诡诈；

zhTraditional.text: 怨恨人的，用嘴粉飾， 心裏卻藏着詭詐；

en.text: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

zhSimplified.text: 他用甜言蜜语，你不可信他， 因为他心中有七样可憎恶的。

zhTraditional.text: 他用甜言蜜語，你不可信他， 因為他心中有七樣可憎惡的。

en.text: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

zhSimplified.text: 他虽用诡诈遮掩自己的怨恨， 他的邪恶必在会中显露。

zhTraditional.text: 他雖用詭詐遮掩自己的怨恨， 他的邪惡必在會中顯露。

en.text: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

zhSimplified.text: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中； 滚石头的，石头必反滚在他身上。

zhTraditional.text: 挖陷坑的，自己必掉在其中； 滾石頭的，石頭必反滾在他身上。

en.text: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

zhSimplified.text: 虚谎的舌恨他所压伤的人； 谄媚的口败坏人的事。

zhTraditional.text: 虛謊的舌恨他所壓傷的人； 諂媚的口敗壞人的事。
